title: Canonical integral system realization and proper/open coherence data
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and the actual simultaneous system operations $o$ with $P_f\dashv S_f$ and $J_j\dashv P_j$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Use their typed finite expressions and good-input domains [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain], the canonical section-normalized bridge to varying-ring systems, the completed/ringed expression models and their completion maps [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], the intrinsic semilinear clopen comparison [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons] and its specified proper-adjunction mate [def-coef-semilinear-proper-open-mate]. Define the proper exchange to be the adjunction mate of the normalized pullback square and the proper projection to be the counit-defined right-adjoint tensor projection. For a chosen compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], define compactification exchange by proper exchange followed by the normalized open base-change map, and compactification projection by proper projection followed by open projection and the inverse pullback compositor; retain the corresponding ordinary ringed-site composites.

Given pullback compositors $c$, normalized open comparisons $a$ and canonical bridge $b$, define $\operatorname{ProperOpenCoherence}(o,c,a,b)$ as data of natural transformations $\Gamma_Q:J_iS_r\to S_pJ_k$ for every commuting square with quasi-compact open $k,i$ and proper $r,p$, without a Cartesian assumption. Include the equation saying its transpose under $J_i\dashv P_i$ is $\lambda_Q^{-1}$, where $\lambda_Q$ is the recorded proper/open restriction composite. Include the canonical bridge equation $(b_p)_*\circ\Gamma_Q=(\gamma_Q)\circ(b_r)_*$, with the open bridge factors inserted at the source and target. Include vertical and horizontal pasting with the specified direct-image and open compositors, and base-change compatibility for the four Cartesian side squares, using exactly the open base-change and proper exchange composites.

For a finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], define $\operatorname{Realizations}(D,o)$ to retain $c,a,b$, this proper/open coherence, and the tensor/square exchange-projection equation. For every finite typed geometric expression $e$, retain a natural isomorphism from its reduction-then-system-operation-then-total-limit realization to its completed integral interpretation on exactly $e$'s domain. Include its actual realization model; the standalone open realization normalized by the reduction mate and reconstruction unit; the inverse-unit normalization at variables; and the specified recursive proper-image, pullback, open-extension, tensor and compact-support equations, using the canonical K-flat models for pullback and tensor. Retain the natural reduction comparison in the derived system category, with its equation against the actual reduction-limit counit. Retain ringed tensor/open/proper-open models and invertibility of the recursive completion map on the domain. Define the canonical isomorphism-generator pairs, structural map-generator pairs and their closure under identity, composition and all finite expression contexts using the actual indexed arrows, with no constructor for arbitrary unrelated arrows; require the realization intertwining equation for every such pair. Finally require the finite-projection compact-support equation using the prescribed compactification reduction mate, evaluation maps, transitions and finite-image comparisons. The compactification ambient scheme and open/proper arrows are the actual over-base compactification, and system/ringed expression evaluation uses the recorded interpretations. These are structure types and their explicit helper constructions; no existence or invertibility assertion beyond the recorded structure fields is made.
